customers.description: People who buy from the shop. One row per customer. Revenue, spend and buyers are found by joining orders.

columns.country: Full country name, for example 'United States' or 'India'

products.description: Catalogue of items for sale with category, price and stock level.

orders.description: Purchases placed by customers. One row per order; status tracks fulfilment. Order totals come from order_items.

order_items.description: Line items of each order: which product, how many, at what price. Revenue and sales amounts = quantity * unit_price.

columns.unit_price: Price per unit at purchase time
